content.text: By my count, there were 120 Detroit based business side employees (DONT report to Avila) as of opening day 2019. 45 are gone as of New Years. That’s about 38%. That’s crazy even for sports. 10 of the ones left are box office (which is union) and another major chunk is finance and administration. Granger, by his own admission, really only concentrates on sales and marketing. So, in reality, this stat is padded in their favor. It really is worse.
